instruction: Set the Organization field to "ABC University" for my email account in Thunderbird's account settings.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully opened Thunderbird Account Settings, navigated to identity section, typed a 2-line plain text signature, and completed the task in 6 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open Account Settings in Thunderbird, navigate identity settings panel, edit text fields (signature, organization, name), type multi-line text
metadata.task_rationale: Tests a related identity field (Organization) in the same Account Settings panel the model successfully navigated
metadata.explanation: Task requires setting the Organization field in Thunderbird account identity settings. Evaluator checks mail.identity.id1.organization in prefs.js equals 'ABC University'.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly fetches prefs.js from the Thunderbird profile directory, which stores all user preferences including identity fields.
Metric check_thunderbird_prefs correctly parses user_pref lines and checks mail.identity.id1.organization against 'ABC University' using eq method.
Expected value 'ABC University' exactly matches the instruction requirement.
Postconfig correctly closes Thunderbird before reading prefs.js, ensuring preferences are flushed to disk.
Single instruction requirement is fully covered by the single evaluator check — complete coverage.
Metric correctly handles null result (returns 0.0), addressing the static warning about type mismatch.

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_thunderbird_prefs first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
